topic.title: Common notes
topic.shortdesc: Reusable notes, tips and lists that other topics pull in by conref. This topic is a warehouse and is not published on its own.

body.note: This effect changes the audio data. Save the project first; you can undo with Ctrl+Z or, on macOS, Cmd+Z.
For best results, record in a quiet room and position the microphone 15 to 30 cm from your mouth.

messagepanel.consequence: Sustained listening above 85 dB can damage your hearing permanently.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Set the playback volume low before you press Play and raise it gradually.
Take the headphones off before applying Amplify or Normalize with the track playing.
